text: {"assertions":["On 2026-04-07, a dropped rows bug was discovered and fixed in ingest/pipeline/dedupe.py.","The dropped rows bug only occurred when the pipeline input list was empty.","The root cause was a listener that was registered but never removed, causing memory to accumulate.","The fix involved removing the listener during teardown and adding a test assertion to verify the removal.","The fix was submitted in PR #8689 on the branch fix/dropped-rows-1.","The bug could be reproduced by running the pipeline over overlapping day partitions.","After the fix was applied, the error rate decreased from 3.5% to under 0.05% (5 per ten thousand)."]}
